The paper writes 神州12 for Shenzhou-12 (神舟十二号), translated as Shenzhou-12. The angle θ_c is defined literally as 'the angle between the direction of motion of c and the direction of the polar axis' (c 的运动方向与极轴方向之间的夹角); Fig. 2c shows θ_c as the polar angle of c's position; translated literally. Chinese labels in Figs. 2a–2c kept, translations in square brackets.
